project_info.theme: Da Nang event teaser featuring successful student examples
project_info.color_palette: White, Navy Blue, Red, Sky Blue, Sunset Orange

main_subject.detail: A multi-card student showcase poster for the Đà Nẵng stop of the VFE Du học Pháp 2027 series, combining a main city-ticket card with three student profile cards highlighting admissions to Audencia Business School, INSA Lyon, and ENSA de Clermont-Ferrand.
main_subject.style: Dynamic grid-based event teaser with school-logo overlays, city travel visuals, and testimonial-card collage design.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality testimonial collage poster for the Đà Nẵng stop of the VFE Du học Pháp 2027 series. Centerpiece is a tilted Đà Nẵng event ticket card with Dragon Bridge image, QR code, and the date 01/08/2026, surrounded by four student showcase cards highlighting Tuệ Lâm, Nam An, Mai Phương, and Quốc Việt. Background is a clean white campaign layout with checkerboard French-color borders and VFE branding. Surrounding elements: school logos for Audencia Business School, INSA Lyon, and ENSA de Clermont-Ferrand, plus the headline 'Bạn có hẹn với ĐÀ NẴNG'. Technical style: collage testimonial event teaser poster, bright campaign-card lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
